title: 플리카 작업 (The Fleeca Job)

potentialTake.description: The loot is stored in safety deposit box #153 inside the Fleeca Bank branch.

description: 2인 입문 습격. 서부 고속도로변의 플리카 은행을 습격하고, 안전 금고를 드릴로 뚫은 뒤 카고밥의 전자석으로 탈출합니다.

setupMissions.name: Scope Out
setupMissions.description: Drive with Lester in his Asea to the Fleeca Bank branch, examine the cameras, and complete the firewall hack mini-game.

setupMissions.name: Kuruma
setupMissions.description: Raid the top floor of a guarded parking garage in Little Seoul controlled by Korean mobsters to steal the armored Karin Kuruma.

setupMissions.name: The Fleeca Job (Finale)
setupMissions.description: Arrive at the branch, neutralize the security cameras, intimidate the tellers, drill safe box 153, and escape to the bridge where an electro-magnet Cargobob lifts your car.

tips: Push the drill forward smoothly and gently to prevent it from overheating while opening the deposit box.
The driver should immediately destroy the security cameras and fire near the tellers to maintain intimidation.

title: 탈옥 (The Prison Break)

potentialTake.description: Government contract payout for the live extraction of Professor Maxim Rashkovsky.

description: 4인 팀의 본격 탈옥 작전. 교도관과 죄수로 위장하여 삼엄한 볼링브로크 교도소에 침투하고, 라스코브스키 교수를 비행기로 해외 탈출시킵니다.

setupMissions.name: Plane
setupMissions.description: Steal the smuggler Velum aircraft from Vagos gang members at McKenzie Airfield.

setupMissions.name: Bus
setupMissions.description: Hijack an official prison transport bus on the highway, lose the police heat, and stash it in Sandy Shores.

setupMissions.name: Station
setupMissions.description: One team disguised as cops steals the prisoner transfer schedule from a police station, while the other team steals the Casco from a cargo ship.

setupMissions.name: Wet Work
setupMissions.description: Simultaneously assassinate Rashkovsky's corrupt business partners and defense attorney at City Hall and a private mansion.

setupMissions.name: The Prison Break (Finale)
setupMissions.description: Infiltrate Bolingbroke in the prison bus, fight through prison guards, extract Rashkovsky into the Velum, dodge fighter jets, and parachute down to the beach.

tips: The Velum pilot can fly right behind military jets to prevent them from firing homing missiles without needing the Buzzard to destroy them.
Demolition should protect the prison bus before boarding the Buzzard.

title: 휴메인 연구소 습격 (The Humane Labs Raid)

potentialTake.description: Classified biological and chemical warfare research files.

target: IAA 극비 생물학 연구 데이터 파일
location: Humane Labs, San Chianski Mountain Range
description: 군사급 첨단 강습 작전. 야간 투시경을 착용하고 야간 낙하산 강하 후, EMP로 정전된 시설에서 IAA의 극비 연구 데이터를 탈취합니다.

setupMissions.name: Key Codes
setupMissions.description: Meet the contact in a downtown alleyway to obtain security keycards under heavy FIB ambush.

setupMissions.name: Insurgents
setupMissions.description: Steal two heavy armored Insurgent military vehicles from Merryweather at Davis Quartz quarry.

setupMissions.name: EMP
setupMissions.description: Infiltrate the aircraft carrier USS Luxington at sea, steal the Hydra VTOL jet carrying the EMP, and dogfight enemy fighter jets.

setupMissions.name: Valkyrie
setupMissions.description: Raid the Merryweather naval base at Terminal docks to steal the heavy Valkyrie gunship helicopter.

setupMissions.name: Deliver EMP
setupMissions.description: Pure stealth mission: sneak an Insurgent disguised as a delivery truck into Humane Labs without triggering any alarms.

setupMissions.name: The Humane Labs Raid (Finale)
setupMissions.description: EMP blackout, night-vision parachute drop, data extraction inside the lab, underwater scuba escape through coolant pipes, and an epic aerial gunship dogfight.

tips: In Deliver EMP, synchronize suppressed shots with your teammates to drop pairs of scientists simultaneously.
The ground team should equip Rebreathers before diving into the water coolant pipes.

title: 시리즈 A 자금 조달 (Series A Funding)

potentialTake.description: Profits generated from bulk wholesale distribution of acquired contraband.

location: El Burro Heights warehouse / Sandy Shores
description: 트레버 필립스를 위해 경쟁 갱단의 마약 기지를 기습 및 탈취하고, 엘 고르도 등대에서의 최종 방어전을 돌파합니다.

setupMissions.name: Coke
setupMissions.description: Raid a luxury yacht anchored off Del Perro to steal packages of cocaine and escape in helicopters and speedboats.

setupMissions.name: Trash Truck
setupMissions.description: Use a Trashmaster garbage truck to collect bags of pills across Vagos turf while enduring intense gang gunfire.

setupMissions.name: Bikers
setupMissions.description: Night stealth infiltration into the Lost MC camp at Stab City with silenced AP pistols to steal loaded vans.

setupMissions.name: Weed
setupMissions.description: Frontal assault on the Paleto Forest sawmill controlled by the Ballas to secure flatbed trucks with mounted machine guns.

setupMissions.name: Steal Meth
setupMissions.description: Attack the O'Neil brothers' meth farm in Grapeseed and drive away with an explosive fuel tanker.

setupMissions.name: Series A Funding (Finale)
setupMissions.description: Defend Trevor's warehouse in El Burro Heights from incoming gang hit squads and escort the technical trucks down the freeway.

tips: In the Trash Truck setup, collectors should consume snacks from the weapon wheel constantly while carrying bags in the open.
Place proximity mines in spawn alleys around the warehouse before triggering the finale shootout.

title: 퍼시픽 스탠다드 작업 (The Pacific Standard Job)

potentialTake.description: Main bank vault cash. Taking hits while carrying money bags reduces the payout.

description: 로스 산토스 역사상 최대 규모의 클래식 은행 강도. 도심의 퍼시픽 스탠다드 은행 중앙 금고를 서멀 차저로 폭파하고, 오토바이로 협곡을 질주해 탈출합니다.
eliteChallenges: No NOOSE called (no alarms or teller alerts)

setupMissions.name: Vans
setupMissions.description: Photograph license plates of Post OP vans across the city to track down the Pacific Standard transponder.

setupMissions.name: Signal
setupMissions.description: Rescue signal expert Avi Schwartzman on an isolated island off Chumash surrounded by police boats.

setupMissions.name: Hack
setupMissions.description: Steal a decryption module from a rival gang in Vinewood and use a decoy van to mislead bank investigators.

setupMissions.name: Convoy
setupMissions.description: Ambush a heavily armed Merryweather military convoy crossing the Raton Canyon bridge to seize the thermal charges.

setupMissions.name: Bikes
setupMissions.description: Steal four high-performance Principe Lectro motorcycles with KERS boost from the Lost MC clubhouse.

setupMissions.name: The Pacific Standard Job (Finale)
setupMissions.description: Bank robbery with crowd intimidation, vault breach, alleyway firefight against cops, motorcycle canyon chase, and cliff parachute jump to the getaway boat.

tips: To preserve the maximum payout, have a single player pick up all the money and stay protected behind the team during the street shootout.
Do not shoot any bank tellers to avoid triggering NOOSE tactical response units.

titleEn: The Doomsday Heist: Act I - The Data Breaches

setupMissions.name: Freemode Preps: Deluxo & Akula
setupMissions.description: Acquire tactical hardware and vehicles in public or private freemode lobbies.

setupMissions.name: Setup: Dead Courier
setupMissions.description: Infiltrate the city coroner's morgue disguised as paramedics to extract hard drive data.

setupMissions.name: Setup: Signal Intercepts
setupMissions.description: Hack trucks, speedboats, and a military cargo plane using amphibious hovercraft Deluxos.

setupMissions.name: Setup: Server Farm
setupMissions.description: Fly a stealth Akula to the government server facility and steal classified target lists.

setupMissions.name: The Data Breaches (Finale)
setupMissions.description: Assault the overrun IAA underground facility, deploy automated defense turrets, and contain the digital breach.

tips: Use tear gas or rocket launchers on the elevated catwalks to eliminate heavy shotgun agents before accessing server terminals.

title: 심판의 날: 2막 - 보그단 문제
titleEn: The Doomsday Heist: Act II - The Bogdan Problem

setupMissions.name: Freemode Preps: Stromberg & Torpedoes
setupMissions.description: Retrieve military technology across San Andreas.

setupMissions.name: Setup: Rescue ULP
setupMissions.description: Storm an oil refinery to rescue captured government agent ULP under heavy enemy siege.

setupMissions.name: Setup: Salvage Hard Drives
setupMissions.description: Extinguish fires and recover sensitive hard drives using the armored water cannon RCV.

setupMissions.name: Setup: Submarine Recon
setupMissions.description: Underwater combat destroying sea mines using submersible Stromberg sports cars.

setupMissions.name: The Bogdan Problem (Finale)
setupMissions.description: Board the Ramyus submarine to confront Commander Bogdan while the Avenger provides coastal air defense.

tips: The Avenger team can engage auto-pilot at high altitude to operate the heavy turrets without danger of crashing.

title: 심판의 날: 3막 - 심판의 날 시나리오
titleEn: The Doomsday Heist: Act III - The Doomsday Scenario

potentialTake.description: Maximum reward for saving the world from nuclear obliteration orchestrated by Clifford.

target: 칠리아드 산 내부의 핵미사일 사일로 기지
description: 칠리아드 산 깊은 곳의 핵미사일 발사 기지로의 최종 돌격. 제트팩 '스러스터'를 타고 클리포드의 핵 발사 카운트다운을 저지합니다.

setupMissions.name: Freemode Preps: Khanjali, Volatol & Jetpack
setupMissions.description: Secure experimental military hardware across the map.

setupMissions.name: Setup: Rescue Agent 14
setupMissions.description: Battle cloaked soldiers using active optical camouflage at an abandoned shipyard.

setupMissions.name: Setup: Escort ULP / Chernobog
setupMissions.description: Defend the mobile ballistic missile system from military air strikes.

setupMissions.name: Setup: Barrage & Khanjali
setupMissions.description: Raid military air bases to secure the heavy armored ground vehicles.

setupMissions.name: The Doomsday Scenario (Finale)
setupMissions.description: Khanjali tank breach into Mount Chiliad, intense command center firefight, 4-terminal orbital hack mini-game, and Thruster jetpack aerial duel.

tips: During the 4-terminal hack mini-game, teammates must hold the perimeter with Mk II Combat MGs and incendiary heavy rifles.

title: 다이아몬드 카지노 습격 (The Diamond Casino Heist)

potentialTake.description: Dynamic vault loot: Cash ($2.1M), Artwork ($2.3M), Gold ($2.5M), or Diamonds ($3.6M during special event weeks).

location: The Diamond Casino & Resort, East Vinewood
description: 다양한 접근 방식(대사기극, 비밀 작전, 공격 전술)을 기획하여 듀건 가문의 초호화 금고로 침투해 다이아몬드, 금괴, 예술품, 현금을 털어냅니다.
eliteChallenges: Undetected before vault (Stealth/Big Con) or 80 headshots (Aggressive)

setupMissions.name: Casino & Vault Scoping
setupMissions.description: Photograph security doors, sewer access, and tap into cameras to reveal the vault target.

setupMissions.name: Support Crew & Weapons
setupMissions.description: Hire a gunman (Chester McCoy, Gustavo Mota, Packie McReary) and steal suitable weapons.

setupMissions.name: Getaway Vehicles
setupMissions.description: Hire a getaway driver (Karim Denz, Eddie Toh) and steal customized getaway vehicles.

setupMissions.name: Hacking Device & Keycards
setupMissions.description: Hire an expert hacker (Avi Schwartzman or Paige Harris) to maximize vault time before nerve gas is released.

setupMissions.name: Approach-Specific Equipment
setupMissions.description: Gruppe Sechs outfits, Bugstars gear, thermal charges, EMP devices, or reinforced armor.

setupMissions.name: The Diamond Casino Heist (Finale)
setupMissions.description: Infiltration via selected method, fingerprint keypad hack, timed vault looting, and escape through sewers to the police rooftop helicopter.

approaches.name: Silent & Sneaky
approaches.description: Night stealth with silenced weapons, camera stunners, EMP blackout, and rappel ropes.

approaches.name: The Big Con
approaches.description: Walk right through the front door disguised as Gruppe Sechs armored guards or Bugstars exterminators.

approaches.name: Aggressive
approaches.description: Frontal brute force with thermal charges, reinforced ballistic suits, and heavy firepower.

tips: Recommended hacker: Avi Schwartzman (unlocked by destroying all 50 signal jammers) or Paige Harris grants 3 minutes and 30 seconds inside the vault.
For the easiest getaway, exit through the staff lobby, steal the police helicopter from the nearby station roof, and fly straight to the buyer.

title: 카요 페리코 습격 (The Cayo Perico Heist)

potentialTake.description: Primary Target (Panther Statue $1.9M-$2.09M, Pink Diamond $1.3M-$1.43M, Bearer Bonds $1.1M-$1.21M, Ruby Necklace $1M-$1.1M, Tequila $900k-$990k) + Secondary Targets (Gold, Cocaine, Paintings, Weed, Cash).

location: Private island of Cayo Perico, Caribbean Sea
description: 마약왕 엘 루비오의 사유 요새 섬으로 잠입합니다. 완전 솔로 플레이가 가능하며, 코사트카 배수 터널 침투 및 다양한 탈출 경로를 선택할 수 있습니다.
eliteChallenges: 0 hack failures on compound fingerprint scanner

setupMissions.name: Cayo Perico Scoping
setupMissions.description: Fly to the island disguised as a tour musician, sneak to the radio communication tower, and hack security cameras to identify loot.

setupMissions.name: Approach Vehicle
setupMissions.description: Secure entry method: Kosatka torpedoes (drainage tunnel), Longfin boat, Alkonost stealth HALO jump, or smuggler Velum.

setupMissions.name: Weapons & Suppressors
setupMissions.description: Raid an agency or gang office to steal loadouts (Conspirator, Crack Shot, Aggressor) with night suppressors.

setupMissions.name: Equipment
setupMissions.description: Steal the plasma cutter, fingerprint cloner, and cutting torch.

setupMissions.name: The Cayo Perico Heist (Finale)
setupMissions.description: Underwater drainage tunnel infiltration, silent guard kills, office fingerprint hack, vault extraction, and ocean swim escape.

approaches.name: Drainage Pipe (Kosatka)
approaches.description: The fastest speedrun method: enter directly inside El Rubio's courtyard by cutting underwater iron bars.

approaches.name: Longfin Speedboat
approaches.description: Top solo strategy: land at the North Dock or Airstrip to fill loot bags with cocaine or paintings before hitting the compound.

approaches.name: HALO Parachute Jump (Alkonost)
approaches.description: High-altitude military stealth drop with flares to bypass El Rubio's radar.

tips: To escape in under 10 minutes: exit through the front gate, shoot the guard with the motorbike on the left, ride off the southern cliff, and swim underwater away from the island.
The cutting torch cuts warehouse padlocks silently without needing guard keys.

setupMissions.name: Hit and Run

Choosing The Professionals weapon loadout in setup 2 gives you military rifles with suppressors for a quiet factory breach.

propertyRequired: Luxury Mansion with Art Studio (Prix Luxury Real Estate)

potentialTake.description: The highest paying heist in GTA Online. Primary Target: The Albert Crisp Art Collection ($2.0M - $2.2M on first weekly run) plus high-value gallery antiquities.

target: 코츠 센터 내부 FIB 극비 아카이브
description: 코츠 센터 미술관 정원과 전시실에서 펼쳐지는 삼파전 전술 총격전.
eliteChallenges: No alarms raised / private security undetected

setupMissions.name: Art Forgery Fabrication
setupMissions.description: Contract a specialist forger in your mansion's art studio to craft exact replica paintings and sculptures.

setupMissions.name: Security Jammers & Feed Hijack
setupMissions.description: Hijack military signal jammers from Merryweather to disable weight sensors and display case lasers.

setupMissions.name: Tactical Gear & Suppressed Arsenal
setupMissions.description: Acquire night-infiltration stealth suits and suppressed firearms for a whisper-quiet heist execution.

setupMissions.name: The Kortz Center Heist (Finale)
setupMissions.description: Infiltrate the Kortz Center, neutralize private security, swap originals for replicas, and exfiltrate by air or sea to the private buyer.

tips: Currently the most profitable heist in GTA Online history, overtaking Cayo Perico with over $2.2M on your first weekly run.
Swapping masterworks with forgeries prevents security from noticing the theft until hours after your clean getaway.
Fulfilling the Buyer's Request objective awards a massive secondary bonus on top of Elite Challenge payouts.
